title: Pear-cat harvest-event study
purpose: Explore one rare orchard customer or harvest surprise that reuses the proven reach, carry, serve, contact, and receipt verbs without replacing the Pipi Labu owner, player, or baby customer cast.

source.fallback_brief: Jon-supplied visual correction for ART-006: a warm tan/golden, nearly spherical orchard cat/loaf with extremely tiny side-folded ears, feline eyes, nose, mouth, whiskers, paws, and heavy hand-squash. The account/reference nickname may say pear-cat, but the visual essence is a round golden cat harvested from a tree and gathered in a basket, not a literal green pear or stemmed fruit creature. It must remain clearly distinct from the Pipi Labu dog cast and never replace the owner, babies, or player. Explore it only as a rare orchard customer, harvest surprise, or future sourcing encounter reusing reach/carry/serve verbs. Re-author an original, rights-safe design; do not copy watermarks, Instagram UI, or a specific creator's exact asset. Fruit may remain as surrounding orchard context or a receipt prop. Show silhouette/readability at Roblox gameplay scale and at least three expressions or states relevant to harvest/contact/receipt.

local_doctrine_refs.reason: canonical tiny-side-ear dog identity, gated orchard sourcing, and reusing existing verbs
approved rendered Pipi Labu face/material language and reference translation rules
serve/contact/receipt loop and future rare-event boundaries
isolated review-candidate lane and no-promotion rule
current private-play identity and gameplay gate context

identity_contract.family_boundary: The pear-cat nickname is a ticket label, not literal fruit anatomy. The golden orchard cat is not a Pipi Labu owner, player avatar, baby customer, or replacement canonical cast member.
visual_distinction: warm tan/golden cat-loaf palette rather than the approved Pipi Labu caramel/cream dog palette
near-spherical heavy hand-squash with a broad grounded lower edge; fruit is context, not body anatomy
narrow feline eyes, cat nose/mouth, whiskers, and paw language rather than the dog muzzle/urajiro mask
extremely tiny lateral folded ear hints swallowed into the fur contour; no top or upright ears
identity_contract.rights_safety: Original authored study only. Do not reproduce watermarks, social UI, a named creator's composition, or a specific reference asset.

silhouette_contract.body_read: near_spherical heavy hand-squashed cat loaf with a broad grounded lower edge and no literal pear taper
silhouette_contract.ear_rule: two extremely tiny lateral side-folded hints remain below the crown tangent and nearly disappear into the fur contour; no top or upright ears
forbidden_geometry: stem or leaf growing from the cat crown
dog muzzle or cream forehead mask
silhouette_contract.mobile_read_test: At a 420 px review thumbnail and an estimated 10-14 stud gameplay distance, the tan/golden circular cat-loaf, nearly hidden side ears, feline eye direction/whiskers, and hand-held receipt fruit must read before facial detail.

material_contract.direction: Approved rendered v4 quality remains the production bar; this flat board is a decision surface, not a replacement material asset.
material_contract.base: warm tan/golden fur-loaf with honey light and toasted brown shadow
material_contract.accent: ruby contact fruit, muted plum feline features, whisker strokes, bark brown basket/tree context
material_contract.finish: soft authored fur/loaf response with eye and nose catchlights in any future render
do_not: copy the Pipi Labu caramel/cream urajiro hierarchy as the main identity
make the body green, literal pear-shaped, or stemmed
add noisy rarity particles or UI clutter
make the fruit prop visually compete with the receiving face

gameplay_scale_rules: body silhouette remains one readable golden cat-loaf beside the existing 1.3 stud apple
hands/paws never hide the contact fruit completely
tree and basket are context landmarks, not collision clutter
future rig may use the existing customer presentation verbs but must be authored as a separate identity

states.label: TREE HANG
states.context: cat-loaf hangs or rests on an orchard branch among apples
states.pose: round body nestled against the branch, paws tucked, eyes soft but alive
states.interaction: arrival or discovery only; no new prompt or economy rule
states.mobile_read: gold cat-loaf + branch/apples + tiny ears + relaxed feline eyes

states.label: HAND SQUASH
states.context: harvester hands gently gather and compress the soft round cat-loaf
states.pose: two visible hands press the sides without hiding the feline face
states.interaction: reuses carry/hold; no new capture or squeeze mechanic is introduced here
states.mobile_read: side hands + compressed gold loaf + narrow feline eyes

states.label: BASKET CLUSTER
states.context: cat-loaf rests in a basket cluster with gathered apples
states.pose: body stays circular and grounded while paws nestle among fruit context
states.interaction: reuses carry/hold; basket is a context grouping, not a new inventory system
states.mobile_read: basket rim + gold loaf + surrounding apples

states.label: RECEIPT
states.context: serve/contact is the sensory peak; a Ruby apple remains visible between paws
states.pose: both paws frame the receipt fruit without covering the face
states.interaction: reuses serve/contact/hold and existing receipt language
states.mobile_read: red receipt fruit + feline mouth + eye catchlights

mechanic_contract.future_encounter_shape: one rare optional orchard customer or harvest surprise that can be toggled off by default
mechanic_contract.future_sourcing_rule: Do not implement sourcing, plucking, rarity, economy, queue, patience, reward, or audio changes from this sheet alone.
mechanic_contract.sequence_note: The golden orchard cat may enter as a customer or discovery beat, but the existing apple handoff remains the legible center of the event.

future_gate.human_visual_gate: Leo and Jon must review the full sheet and mobile strip at native size and thumbnail size, explicitly deciding accept, revise, or reject. Approval must confirm the warm tan/golden orchard cat reads as feline and distinct from the Pipi Labu dog cast, no top/upright ears, readable contact/receipt state, and no owner/player/baby replacement reading.
future_gate.private_play_gate: Only after visual acceptance and a separately recorded gameplay gate may one disposable local 0/0 sandbox test the candidate at PlaceId 133099029551440 / GameId 10646495069, after verifying the intended Studio instance and Edit access. The test must reuse existing reach/carry/serve/hold verbs with rarity disabled by default.
test_questions: Does the golden orchard cat read as a distinct feline encounter at mobile camera distance within one second?
Does the red apple remain visible at contact without hiding paws, face, or receipt?
Does the encounter preserve queue, prompt, collision, sightline, and service timing?
Does any harvest context improve surprise without becoming a new chore or noisy event system?
future_gate.rollback: Remove the candidate root from the disposable sandbox if it reads as the dog cast, steals attention from serve/contact, adds collision ambiguity, slows targeting, or requires new mechanics to be understood.

out_of_scope: gameplay Luau, Rojo mapping, Studio, place, or cloud changes
new sourcing, rarity, economy, queue, patience, reward, HUD, or audio mechanics
final Blender mesh, PBR maps, rig, animation, collision, or import claim
